faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: You can choose your preferred service or package directly on this website, fill out the project order form with your requirements, and submit it. You will instantly receive a unique Order ID. You can also click "WhatsApp Us" to discuss with Suraj Maurya directly before or after placing your order.

faqs.question: How does payment work? Is there any gateway fee?
faqs.answer: We operate on a 100% Direct Payment model without third-party payment gateways. You pay directly to Suraj Maurya’s official UPI ID or bank account. After transferring the amount, simply submit your Transaction Reference (UTR number) on your order page. We manually verify the transaction and update your order status.

faqs.question: Do you take advance payment?
faqs.answer: Yes, to commence design and development, an initial project advance (usually 50% or as agreed depending on scope) is required. The remaining balance is payable upon project completion and client review before final files or domain handover.

faqs.question: How long does a website take to build?
faqs.answer: A standard Landing Page takes 2 to 4 working days. A full Business Website takes 4 to 7 working days, while complex funnels or custom solutions take 7 to 15 working days. We provide an estimated completion date upon order confirmation.

faqs.question: Can I request revisions?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Every package includes revisions (2 rounds on Starter, 4 rounds on Growth, and extensive revisions on Pro) to guarantee that you are 100% satisfied with the design, layout, colors, and content before final delivery.

faqs.question: Do you provide domain and hosting?
faqs.answer: We provide complete assistance and setup for your domain and hosting on reliable platforms (Hostinger, Cloudflare, Vercel, VPS). If you already own a domain and hosting, we will configure and deploy your website directly to your server.

faqs.question: Can you build a custom website with unique features?
faqs.answer: Yes! We specialize in tailored digital solutions, custom booking forms, automated WhatsApp notifications, course portals, and custom client workflows. Select the "Custom" package or request a custom quote, and we will formulate a personalized proposal.

faqs.question: How do I track my order status?
faqs.answer: Click "Track Order" in the top navigation or footer, enter your unique Order ID along with your registered WhatsApp number or email, and view real-time progress across all 10 stages from requirement review to final delivery.

faqs.question: How can I contact Suraj Maurya directly?
faqs.answer: You can tap the floating WhatsApp button or call/chat directly at our official business WhatsApp number. You can also submit the Contact form or request a custom quote directly from the website.
